display.title: The Chicken with One Leg: A Purim Joke Story
display.summary_short: On Erev Purim, hungry Yonason secretly eats a chicken leg, then insists at the Purim seudah that the chicken was born with only one leg.
display.summary_long: Yonason is a clever boy who learns well in cheder but sometimes acts the wise guy. On the day before Purim he comes home hungry, finds a chicken cooking in the pot, pulls off a leg, makes a brachah and eats it, and cleans up so no one will know. At the Purim seudah, Mommy opens the pot and finds a leg missing. Yonason will not tell a lie, so he suggests that maybe this chicken was born with only one leg, and everyone laughs. The next day Tati takes him for a walk by a river and shows him a duck standing on one leg; when Tati claps his hands, the duck puts down its second foot. Yonason has a quick answer ready: if only Tati had clapped his hands at the table yesterday, the chicken would have put out its second foot too. The storyteller explains that this is a Purim joke story, told to bring simcha.

quality.notes: Short Purim joke story; no theme song. ASR spells the boy's name several ways (Yonason).
